title: King Jaya Sinha
biography: Jaya Sinha ruled Jaffna for seven years, maintaining Hindu patronage and northern trade. His brief reign continued the dynasty's policies of temple-building and irrigation maintenance, sustaining Jaffna's maritime prosperity amid regional volatility.
